game.name: Dance Paradise (USA)
game.desc: Dance Paradise on Xbox 360 is a dance game played with Kinect. Through 3 game modes, solo or with another player, you have to reproduce the movements represented on the screen through 40 songs of international variety (from 50 Cent to Lady Gaga, through Mika or No Doubt). A mode called Video Box also allows you to watch the clips of the different artists on the disc.
